title: [Pre Order] Xbox 25th Anniversary Edition: Controller $119 Controller + Series X 1TB $1249 @ EB Games (EB Plus Required)
body:
Deal: [Pre Order] Xbox 25th Anniversary Edition: Controller $119 Controller + Series X 1TB $1249 @ EB Games (EB Plus Required)

[PainToad] Neither the price of the controller or the console is a bargain. Being a different colour doesn't suddenly make it a bargain.
[RichardL] Pokemon TCG 30th Anniversary dropped at 10am, hence the queue.
[Sleepycat3] Wow, a Zen 2 and RDNA2 console for $1249. shakes head
[TheDukeOfNukem] This is (profanity).
I have been staunch Xbox this gen (and most of last tbh) but ever since the first price rise, it's hard to back any current console tbh. The Series S used to always be on sale for 400, which was a fair price. I was looking forward to the future where that became the RRP and then sales would dip lower. I never thought we'd end up with a six year old console going for 1250. This is (profanity) and I cannot support any of it. Keen as a bean for next gen, but buying a current genner, especially at these prices, would be (profanity) retarded.
The downvote is for OzRRPing though.
[scotty] Your estimated wait time is 28 minutes…
Longer than getting onto a car & driving to a closeby EB Games.
[Fredfloresjr] When Forum post is not enough for this "BARGAIN"
[Nillionaire] I asked permission to repost as deal since I knew the demand would be there and I can handle the inevitable negs and "belongs in forums" 😅
[RichardL] Also available at BIG W - Credits to sss333
[JustWantToSave] Considering this is likely to get scalped, I think it being RRP counts as a deal.
Unfortunate that it's at this point though.
[kingmoron] Nice Xbox controller bit I'm gonna stick with my gay Forza controller for that price
[Golazo] The $25 JB coupon I got from the Coca Cola 007 promo earlier this year came in clutch.
$99.99 for that sweet ass controller!
[kingmoron] In y day Xbox one controllers were $40 and $50!
[Rogue01] Queue and the price of the console 😱🤬😱🤬
Not downing you though, nothing wrong with making people aware of limited edition stuff.
[JustWantToSave] the queue is for pokemon 30th anniversary that had some stuff put back up for pre-order after scalpers had orders cancelled.
The console and controller aren't available on eb for 3.5 hours.
[pineapple12] I got the controller from Big W for $109 with the $10 sign up code. OK deal, but better than RRP.
